long_biography.plain_text:
Barbara Cruising grew from Ante and Marina Trgo’s experience of navigation and hospitality along the Croatian coast. As captain and company leader, Ante combines command with planning itineraries, managing crews and shaping the onboard service offered to charter guests.

His maritime education began with his father and developed through more than three decades at sea. He worked from ordinary seaman through mechanical-engineering and shipmaster roles before leading the family operation. Barbara Cruising now centres on multi-day Adriatic voyages, with Ante and Marina remaining the public leaders of a business involving their sons and a locally based crew.
